defects.detail: Bottom-right box reads 'Ref. Drg. TJC-LLD-PID-XXXX'; datasheet, GA drawing and C&E cross-reference TJC-LLD-PID-6701.
'OPL- OPL-LV-6701-07' (doubled prefix on two lines); 'SEPARATIOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE'; 'Ref. Drg.'; '3"-IA-6702-WĈC-I' (accented C); 'AUTOMATED LOGIC PANEL PANEL FOR INTERLOCK'; 'RCAL'.

'DVC6701 ACTUATOR' overlay where the positioner is DVC6200 and the actuator Fisher 667 (datasheet); LSLL-6710 routed to EFF-4 only (C&E T2 also EFF-2 CLOSE LV-6701); HS-6701 routed to EFF-3 only (C&E T3 also EFF-4); PI-6702 (instrument-air permissive) drawn on the process bottoms line.

No notes block and no datasheet citation; FIC-6702, TIC-6702 and TB-6702 have no counterpart in the datasheet or C&E; the valve sketch carries the advisory sentence 'periodic inspection prevents failures'.
